title: cMCP Catalog Entry
description: A single entry in the cMCP Gateway approved tool catalog, representing one tool from one MCP server.

tool_name.description: The name the agent uses to invoke this tool, e.g. salesforce.query.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for the MCP server.

url.description: Base URL of the MCP server endpoint.

tls_fingerprint.description: Colon-separated SHA-256 TLS certificate fingerprint in OpenSSL format.

spiffe_id.description: SPIFFE SVID for this server; required when SPIFFE is deployed, null otherwise.

transport.description: Transport protocol. stdio means the gateway spawns the server as its own child inside the enclave; see docs/spec/stdio-transport.md.

spawn.description: How to start a stdio server. Required when transport is stdio, ignored otherwise.

binary_digest.description: Expected digest of measure_target. Absent means the server is not pinned, which requires attestation.allow_unmeasured_spawn and is recorded as spawn-unmeasured.

measure_target.description: File the digest covers; defaults to the resolved executable. Set this to the entrypoint for interpreted servers, where the executable is the interpreter and every server on the host would otherwise share one digest.

provenance.description: Server provenance record for this server (spec/server-provenance-v1.md in agentrust-io/trace-spec). Optional: absence is recorded as 'absent' rather than failing, since almost no MCP server has a record today.

record_path.description: Path to the signed provenance record (JSON).

publisher_jwk.description: Public key the record must verify under. Required: the key embedded in a record cannot be used to check that record, because a forgery supplies its own.

allOf.$comment: A network transport needs an endpoint and a pin; stdio has neither.
A stdio server needs to say what the gateway should spawn.

description.description: The tool description text as shown in the catalog.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool input parameters.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool output; null if not specified.

definition_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of approved_definition; used for drift detection.

compliance_domain.description: Compliance classification domain for this tool.

requires_baa.description: True if a Business Associate Agreement is required to invoke this tool.

sensitivity_level.description: Data sensitivity level of information this tool accesses or returns. Validated at catalog load time against the built in vocabulary plus any deployment configured additions (#479), not enumerated here, since the legal set is config dependent.

added_at.description: UTC timestamp at which this entry was added to the catalog.

approved_by.description: Identity of the person or system that approved this catalog entry.

catalog_exception.description: True if this entry was added via the break-glass exception procedure.
